questions.prompt: True or false: “Palestine shares a land border with South Sudan.”

hints.nudge: Read the statement slowly. Does it match what the article says, or has one word been swapped for another?
hints.whereToLook: Look at the Atlas and see which countries touch it.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “_____ has built settlements in both of the Palestinian territories since the start of the occupation.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “built”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Palestine article, under the heading “Government”.

questions.proof: Israel has built settlements in both of the Palestinian territories since the start of the occupation.

questions.prompt: What money is used in Palestine?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the part of the article about the economy, or at the facts for the country.

questions.proof: The money used in Palestine is the new shekel.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Palestine on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Palestine on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Palestine includes the West Bank, including East _____ as the capital city, and the Gaza Strip as part of the Palestinian territories, which are occupied by Israel.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “East”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Palestine article.

questions.proof: Palestine includes the West Bank, including East Jerusalem as the capital city, and the Gaza Strip as part of the Palestinian territories, which are occupied by Israel.
